reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text:
Overall, the app is great, but esp since I’m paying a monthly fee, I feel like it could be A LOT better. I wish we can upload more than 10 items for one study set. 

The podcast portion definitely needs a lot of improvement. Love the idea of having different voices read, but there’s a glitch with it. Sometimes the dialogue specifically says the female is supposed to be speaking/reading, but the male voice will read her part instead. Also, the AI voice from the podcast sounds like an echoey robot sometimes. 🤖

Just wish the app worked better and was more polished for something I’m paying for.

reviews.title: Suggestions for improvement
reviews.text:
I think the app would be better if we can add documents or supporting files to study decks. For instance, if I have a recording that makes a study deck I would also like to upload the lecture slides or additional supplemental information but as of right now that’s not an option. Second suggestion is having a pause, forward, or multiple speed options when listening to recorded content within the app. 
I have a paid version of the app and have been using it for over a month
